messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> Incident IN-4821: high p99 latency observed in eu-west-az5 serving pool. Auto-triggers: latency-sla, queue-depth, kv-cache-eviction.

pagerduty-bot: Paging Maya (oncall) -> @Maya :rotating_light:

Maya: acked. I'm on it, pulling metrics now. Can someone confirm if this is limited to az5 or across region?

Liam: seeing sharp p99 increase starting ~+00:03. CPU on pods in az5 is fine, but GPU mem pressure is high and KV cache eviction rate jumped.

Nina: checking runtime logs, looks like KVCACHE thrash + frequent model reloads for variant rtx-xlarge-q8. Logs: `ERROR kvcache: eviction failed: alloc` repeated.

Alex: are there any customer-facing degradations? Jordan, any active support tickets?

Jordan: one customer (acct-acme) reported slow completions ~2m for single-turn generation. No full failures yet. CS alerted.

Maya: ok plan: 1) try temporary fallback routing to az3 region replica 2) enable degraded-mode (max_tokens cap) for affected routes 3) attempt scale-up of az5 serving pool. Doing in that order to avoid double-trouble.

Liam: initiating routing fallback: `/infra/routing/fallback activate --from eu-west-az5 --to eu-west-az3 --policy capacity-first` -> returning async job id `job_9a3f`.

incident-bot: Routing fallback job job_9a3f started, watch logs at https://console.redwood/dev/routing/jobs/job_9a3f

Nina: trying to repro model reload. Dump of last 12 log lines from runtime agent on node gpu-az5-12:
```
2026-03-14T16:02:11Z runtime INFO model-loader: loading model rtx-xlarge-q8 v2.1
2026-03-14T16:02:13Z runtime WARN kvcache: entry evicted, occupancy 0.95
2026-03-14T16:02:14Z runtime ERROR kvcache: eviction failed: oom-alloc
2026-03-14T16:02:15Z runtime INFO scheduler: try-alloc new shard -> denied quota 403
```

Nina: the 403 on scheduler suggests cluster quota exhaustion when trying to allocate new cache shards. Might be kube resource quota or quota in infra autoscaler.

Maya: Liam, can you attempt autoscaler manual scale? If quota blocks, we escalate to infra.

Liam: running `infra autoscaler scale --pool eu-west-az5-serving --delta +6` -> API returned 422: "region quota exceeded: g4dn.v2-gpu". Will open infra ticket.

Alex: while autoscale is blocked, enable degraded-mode on the top-traffic routes to reduce token usage: `/api/routes/patch {"max_tokens":1024, "batch_window_ms":10}` - applying now to `text-gen` and `chat-stream`.

incident-bot: Route patch applied to `text-gen` and `chat-stream` with rolling window enabled.

Jordan: notified acct-acme with temporary mitigation note: "We've routed your requests through an alternate AZ; you may see slightly higher latency but completions should return faster overall." They acknowledged.

Maya: infra ticket created: INF-7842 - request quota bump for eu-west-az5 GPU family. Pinging infra-oncall. @Liam please post link.

Liam: https://infra.redwood/tickets/INF-7842 - added logs and request for emergency quota until 22:00 UTC. infra-oncall @ops-team notified.

Nina: fallback routing shows healthy handshake with az3, about 25% of traffic now diverted. p99 for routed requests dropping back toward baseline (~450ms).

Maya: good. Next step: enable kvcache eviction throttle to reduce churn: `/runtime/config set kvcache.eviction_threshold=0.9` then monitor. Applying.

incident-bot: config change applied; runtime will respect new threshold in 30s.

Liam: infra replied in ticket: temporary quota granted +4 GPUs for az5, ETA 7 minutes to provision. They also suspect a noisy multi-tenant job causing sudden cache thrash; investigating.

Maya: once infra confirms nodes up, we attempt to scale pool +3 and slowly drain fallback. But keep degraded-mode until stable.

Jordan: updated incident channel and created incident page: https://status.redwood/INC-4821 with customer impact notes and runbook link.

Alex: flagging for postmortem: include model variant load patterns and autoscaler quota behavior. Also, run an eval on tail latency for rtx-xlarge-q8 across azs.

Maya: infra confirms new GPUs provisioned and autoscaler accepted scale-up. Pool scaled +3, node healthchecks green. KV cache eviction rate decreasing.

Nina: monitoring shows p99 trending to normal over 10m. Restoring routing to normal over next 5m.

Liam: roll-back routing fallback: `/infra/routing/fallback deactivate job_9a3f` -> job succeeded. Traffic back to az5 at 16:17 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident IN-4821 status: mitigated -> p99 normalized, degraded-mode still on for observation. No further pages.

Maya: thanks everyone. Action items: 1) infra to investigate noisy tenant and quota policy (INF-7842) 2) runtime to add early-warning metric for kvcache-eviction-rate 3) product to notify customers with follow-up note. I'll file the postmortem.

Alex: +1 on postmortem. Jordan will coordinate customer comms.

Jordan: filing follow-up to affected customers, will include ETA and what we changed.

Maya: closing on-call handoff in 10m, leaving a pointer in #eng-oncall with current state. :white_check_mark:
